label: Metal Gear

provenance.incarnation: Mechanical tribute to The Boss, original MGS3 closed ivory-suit incarnation; color/equipment codes only, never a literal human body.

sources.scope: Original Shinkawa art, third-party mirror; ivory/dark equipment design cues only.
Original PS2 Patriot inventory icon reproduced on a third-party mirror; short stockless M16-derived gun and twin drum, low resolution limits fine detail.

plan.scope: UNAPPROVED visual role plan only. Preserve original actionMap and all move timings/resources. Integrator must check actual renderer action selection, the reviewed selectedActionBySlot expectation and distinct Core taxonomy before any compilation.

concept.description: Entirely mechanical biped Metal Gear: ivory armored hull over black structural spars, broad low sensor head with dark optical slit, diagonal chest equipment rail, asymmetrical anatomical-right dark knee armor translated to the machine right knee, articulated two manipulators and two powered legs. No flesh, hair, ponytail, human face, eyes, fabric or breast-shaped armor. Patriot-inspired ballistic module and retractable mechanical blade preserve captured move meanings.

proposalLimits: Candidate pixel heights and pivots require physical review. A neutral pose on the same image can use a different drawn density; do not approve that value automatically.
Preview datum is proposed from contact pixels. Replace it with a reviewed pelvis/body axis where appropriate.
No source point is inferred from a gun bounding box. Native muzzle or release points must be supplied explicitly.
